subject: spans
emitter-escher-driver
text:
- **escher-driver (in a process that installs escher's sink at `info` or below)**
  - one closed-span line per call to `Session::run`: INFO at target `escher_driver`, `span="command"`, with the recorded ones of `verb`, `cause`, `settled`, `busy`, `passes`, `added`, `removed`, `changed`, then `message="close"`, `time.busy`, `time.idle` — the verb table's twelve words (eight instance-level; the three session-level ones and the tool-level `help` only beside the cause `unknown-verb`), eight cause names (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18), three busy-class words, bools and counts; since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot a shot's line is `span="command" verb="screenshot"` (with `cause` when refused) and holds no image byte, size or dimension — measured: 0 occurrences of the first 64 base64 characters of a shot in the `escher-session` host's and the `mcp` role's stderr at `trace`, under both builds (`host_log`, `mcp_log`; examples/seven_guis/tests/host_log.rs:251-264; examples/seven_guis/tests/mcp_log.rs:141-154); a lint's line is `span="command" verb="lint"` (with `cause` when refused) and holds no finding, id, bound or count — `host_log` and `mcp_log` each drive one `lint` at `trace` with 0 needles; a part read's line is `span="command" verb="snapshot"` (with `cause` when refused, a `part` outside 1 to 1000 refused `malformed`) and holds no part number, count, size or text — `host_log` and `mcp_log` each drive one part read at `trace` with 0 needles; no line at the default `warn`; the emitters are the two re-run children of `stand_act_spans`, in process, and since 2026-10-10-driver-cli the `escher-session` host — its wire (`v3`) carries `hello`, `stop` and `call` — a call after which the host's recording ended answered by the one fixed reply `recording-failed` —, and its host role writes one closed-span line per call at `info` or below (measured at `trace`: 3 lines for 3 calls);
 since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface also the `escher-session mcp` role and `serve_mcp` in process (`stand_mcp_tools`); `seven_guis_native` runs none (packages/escher-driver/src/execute.rs:96-111; packages/escher-driver/src/execute.rs:302-341; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/report.md, the host's lines at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-driver-cli/report.md)
  - since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface, one closed-span line per MCP tool call: INFO at target `escher_driver`, `span="tool_call"`, with the recorded ones of `tool` (the table's word, one of its twelve, `help` among them since 2026-10-12-self-description and `screenshot` since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot, and `lint`) and `ending` (`accepted` · `refused` · `error`), then `message="close"`, `time.busy`, `time.idle` — e.g. `span="tool_call" tool="start" ending="accepted" message="close"`; a `help` call's line reads `span="tool_call" tool="help" ending="accepted"` with no `command` line beside it; no line at the default `warn`; the emitters are the `escher-session mcp` role and `serve_mcp` in process; over one CRUD flow at `info` the role's stderr reads 9 lines built alone and 10 built with the workspace — the tenth `INFO blitz_dom::document … message=[redacted]` — with 5 `tool_call` and 3 `command` lines in each (packages/escher-driver/src/mcp.rs:118-121; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-mcp-surface/report.md, read on the hand-run role, 2026-10-11); re-measured at 2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep, 9 built alone and 11 built with the workspace — the `blitz_dom::document` INFO line now printing twice — the 5 `tool_call` and 3 `command` lines unchanged, needles 0 (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep/evidence/log-counts.md)

subject: pii
text:
- Past escher's scrub: the chained std panic hook prints the raw panic message to stderr, and the allowlisted `log.file` can still carry a host path, now only for a bridged `log` record under an engine target (`js_console`) — the bridged third-party records that carried one at `RUST_LOG=info` (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-telemetry-bootstrap/report.md) are dropped whole since 2026-10-07-sink-target-allowlist (recorded by construction, not measured: a dropped record writes zero bytes, and `log.file` occurrences were not counted in that chunk's readings). A record from a target outside the sink's allowlist no longer reaches stderr at all (Scrubbing, below) — measured before → after the drop on both sink-installing binaries at four `RUST_LOG` settings, as stderr lines and as the instrument's fixed id and name needles found: the `escher-session` binary (the CRUD task, one `hello`, then `stop`) 0 → 0 lines unset (the default `warn`), 1 → 1 at `info`, 1165 → 1 at `debug` with ids 15 of 15 → 0, 1501 → 1 at `trace` with ids 15 of 15 → 0 and names 6 of 6 → 0; the windowed `seven_guis_native` (left on Home for 10 s, nobody clicks — its first reading by level) 1 → 0 lines unset, 3 → 1 at `info`, 12,413 → 1 at `debug` with ids 11 of 11 → 0, 47,482 → 1 at `trace` with ids 11 of 11 → 0 and names 5 of 5 → 0; the one line left at `info`, `debug` and `trace` is the install line `INFO escher_telemetry`, and stdout is 0 bytes in all 16 readings.
 Typed text was first measured in process: since 2026-10-07-act-by-id a typing command exists — the driver's `type`, through `Session::run` — and types into an instance held in process; `stand_act_spans`'s re-run child drove the six instance-level verbs of that day, `type` included, with the sink installed over a capture at `RUST_LOG=info`, in both layout modes, and the capture holds 0 of 36 id needles, 0 of 8 name needles and 0 occurrences of the three supplied texts (the typed text, the id naming no element, the unknown verb's text), with no value reading redacted on a driver line; the verb table held seven since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot, when `stand_act_spans` also began checking a refused shot's `fonts-unavailable` cause on the span, and holds eight with the `lint` verb, whose accepted line and refused no-font line `stand_act_spans` also reads (35 calls per mode, eight verbs read back, a part read among them, its line `verb` alone). A shot's image is screen content that leaves only in its answer: 0 occurrences of the first 64 base64 characters of a shot in the `escher-session` host's and the `mcp` role's stderr at `trace`, under both builds (`host_log`, `mcp_log`; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-12-headless-screenshot/report.md).
 Typed text in a HOST's log is measured since 2026-10-10-driver-cli: a hosted `type` reaches the `escher-session` host's instance, and that host's stderr at `RUST_LOG=trace` holds 0 occurrences of the typed sentinel, 0 id needles and 0 name needles under both builds (`host_log` green as `-p seven_guis` and as `--workspace`); by level, on a snapshot · click · type flow with three commands, the host built alone writes 0 lines unset and 4 at `info`, `debug` and `trace` — three command-span lines and the install line, 742 B — and the workspace-built host 5, one `blitz_dom::document` INFO line more, 860 B, with 0 of 15 id needles, 0 of 6 name needles and 0 sentinel occurrences at every level and stdout 0 B in all eight runs (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-driver-cli/evidence/by-level.md); since 2026-10-14-quality-gates the three readings that left out are taken too — a client's own stderr, the host on flows beyond those three commands, and the windowed `seven_guis_native` built with the workspace, on the host's display (`wayland-1`) — 28 runs by build and level, 0 needles in every run (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-quality-gates/evidence/stderr-by-level.md); re-measured at 2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep on the same flow, the host built alone is unchanged (4 lines, 742 B) and the workspace-built host writes 6 lines, 978 B — the `blitz_dom::document` `focussed node` INFO line now printing twice where it printed once, its message `[redacted]` — with the id, name and typed-sentinel needles still 0 at `info` and `trace` under both builds (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep/evidence/log-counts.md).
 The session host's reading above, of a host that runs no call, was re-measured unchanged at 2026-10-07-driver-command-spans — 0 · 1 · 1 · 1 stderr lines, ids 0 of 15, names 0 of 6, stdout 0 B (the readings above as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-sink-target-allowlist/evidence/by-level.md; the typing command at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-act-by-id/report.md; the in-process capture and the re-measurement at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/report.md).
 The sink allowlist re-checked after the upstream take read at `f9cbb2756` holds: no scrub set, redaction shape or violation schema moves, `packages/escher-telemetry/`, `packages/escher-driver/` and `packages/dioxus-native-dom/` unchanged; `host_log` and `mcp_log` (the host's and the `mcp` role's stderr at `trace`, read for id, name and typed-sentinel needles) pass in the per-package and the workspace build; the taken commits' added engine lines hold one commented `dbg!` and no log site, `hit_test_dropped_nodes` reads 0 env · 0 print · 0 subscriber, and the root example `multi_doc` writes its timings with one `println!` to stdout, outside escher's sink, holding no page or user content (as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-24-upstream-sync-polish-and-ship/report.md)
